name: worktree
description: Worktree management for workbench-shaped indusk projects — per-repo config, scripts that author and refresh worktrees with upstream-file-overlay support, and a `pnpm wt <slug> <cmd>` execution surface for running commands inside any worktree (env layering via the doppler extension or worktree-config copy/append; legacy composable.env setups still compose)

hooks.on_disable: echo 'worktree extension disabled — scripts in <workbench>/scripts/worktree/ + package.json entries are left in place for manual cleanup'
